title: Introduction and overview — Mazda Cosmo (1967-1972)
description: Introduction and overview of the Mazda Cosmo (1967-1972): What this car is, its place in automotive history, and why collectors care. The Mazda Cosmo 110S was the first production car with a twin-rotor rotary engine, launching Mazda's rotary era. Only 343 Series I/II Cosmos were built, but the car proved the Wankel could work in a production sports car — leading to the RX-7 and the 1991 Le Mans-winning 787B. Baseline facts: Japanese coupe 1967-1972; 343 built by Mazda; first twin-rotor production car..
